1. How does your prompt ensure that the model considers both fixed and flexible activity durations when identifying implicit gaps, and what specific wording in your prompt directs the model to evaluate the impact of early starts or late finishes on free time?

2. What modifications could you make to the prompt to explicitly require the model to prioritize the most critical or longest potential free periods first, and how would this improve the efficiency and accuracy of the final plausibility assessment?
